Hi,

sorry for not responding earlier. Right now RKWard does not support MacOS X.
Besides the troubles you already ran into, there are some more lingering in
rembedinternal.cpp, and potentially a few other files.

While we certainly hope to support MacOS in the future, we'd really need some
help in the port. If you have some development knowledge, your help will be
much appreciated. You can best contact us on rkward-devel at lists dot sourceforge
dot net about this, and we'll try to help out, where we can. But if you're just
looking for an easy solution to compile RKWard on MacOS, we just can't provide
that, yet.

Regards
Thomas
